invariance_contract: node identity is an unordered pair of containing facets; all summaries are invariant to facet and vertex relabeling
node weight is unsigned symplectic two-face area divided by sqrt(volume), invariant under Sp(4), translation, and positive scaling up to f64 reconstruction
two nodes are adjacent exactly when their reconstructed two-faces share at least two vertices (a polytope edge)
top quartile uses ceil(face_count/4), ordered by normalized area with face index only as an exact-tie breaker
target_boundary: panel selection used sys/residuals; geometry summaries do not consume sys but remain post-selection G evidence and are not proposer validation or mechanism
